rationale.complete: Round 1 plus round 1b: all 282 days re-run on the corrected activity table with the DQ8 trim variant, the H19 reference recomputed on the same table, post hoc size scaling re-run, three period-native tests (NE43 drive withdrawal, #51 N sweep, NE42 room merge). Holdout not run; the lagged dial (R1) is still missing.
rationale.faithfulness: Up from 1.5: on corrected data the dial reproduces H19 on the same table (P3a passes, talk rho 0.97) and agrees with an independent Hawkes fit (P4a passes, rho 0.46); NE43 confirms it ignores drive withdrawal (E = 1); talk follows J0/N (alpha 1.25 [0.77, 1.77]). Still failing: P1 on content (field-like), P5, P7a; the #51 size-law test is uninformative and the NE42 talk collapse was not predicted; activity feedback mostly vanishes after trimming.
rationale.usefulness: compute_dial(...) with calibrated intervals and a working stall detector, now with a cross-method check (Hawkes) and a clear preprocessing rule (trim to the common running window: activity median 0.16 -> 0.07). Operator rules: track per-pair correlation, use weekly means, trim first. Still blind to slow context-mediated herding.
